jobs.description:
Welcome to the IT Security team at Fresenius Digital Technology! We are responsible for the implementation, management and operation of programs, projects and services for a wide range of different security capabilities in various business segments within the Fresenius Group.

We are looking for a highly motivated team member who will ensure that security controls for AI platforms and models are thoughtfully designed, continuously maintained, and fully embedded into engineering and operational processes. You will work closely with enabling teams across the CISO pillars, leveraging existing security services and enhancing them with AI-specific capabilities and patterns.

You can look forward to a working environment that is as challenging as it is attractive. One that fits the ideal of a top workplace in so many respects - while expanding our own expert skills bank.

Join us as an AI Security Lead (m/f/d).

Your responsibilities:

- Design, implement, and continuously maintain security controls covering AI platforms, models, data pipelines, and inference environments
- Embed AI-specific security requirements into engineering, MLOps, and day-to-day operational processes
- Partner with SOC/CERT, IAM, Cloud Security, Platform Security and Security Management to extend existing security services with AI-specific capabilities and patterns, rather than building parallel structures
- Establish consistent, scalable security patterns and guardrails for AI use cases to prevent fragmented or inconsistent risk treatment across business units
- Act as the enterprise point of expertise on emerging AI risks (model poisoning, data leakage, adversarial inputs, misuse of generative outputs), proactively identifying and mitigating them before they materialize into incidents
- Collaborate with different stakeholders in the group to integrate AI security controls into enterprise AI/ML platforms and CI/CD pipelines

Your qualifications:

- Deep experience in designing, operating, and scaling enterprise security controls, with strong operational ownership and seamless integration into SOC/CERT, IAM, cloud, and CI/CD environments
- Strong understanding of AI/ML platforms (data pipelines, model training, inference, model repositories) and AI-specific threats such as model poisoning, data leakage, adversarial inputs, and misuse of generative outputs
- Proven ability to embed AI security controls into enterprise platforms and workflows
- Hands-on experience with AI/ML security techniques, tools, or frameworks such as adversarial ML, model scanning, AI guardrails, MITRE ATLAS, and secure AI lifecycle approaches
- Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging regulations such as the EU AI Act, with experience translating these into practical technical controls
- Experience shaping multi-year security capability roadmaps, building investment cases, and managing specialist vendors delivering AI security tooling and services
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, as well as strong analytical skills and an independent, responsible work style
- Business-fluent English is required; German language skills are an advantage

Our offer

Join #futurefresenius and become part of a challenging and attractive working environment that fits the ideal of a top workplace in many respects, while expanding your expert skills.

Contact

Apply now through our online portal to make an impact!

Apply now (https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=106724&tc=3-11)

Deine VisionWe are Bloomwell, the most exciting health tech scale up in medical cannabis. Our goal is to make access to therapy as simple as possible for patients. We bring medical cannabis into everyday life, digital, simple and patient centric. And we are growing fast.

That is why we need you, as Business Development Manager , to own the next stage of our growth and take Bloomwell beyond Germany. We are evaluating International markets and you lead the work of turning that opportunity into reality. You research possible markets, build the entry strategy, set up the right partnerships and structures, and make sure our launches actually succeed rather than just look good on paper. You work closely with management and take full ownership of your domain.
Deine Aufgaben
• Develop and drive market entry strategies for our international markets, tailored to the regulatory and competitive environment of each country
• Conduct in depth market research covering demand, competitors, pricing and regulatory requirements for medical cannabis and related health products
• Build a repeatable market entry playbook covering legal compliance, licensing, local partnerships and operational setup
• Identify, evaluate and negotiate with local partners such as distributors, pharmacies, clinics and logistics providers
• Own the business case and commercial plan for each market, including pricing, unit economics and growth levers
• Coordinate cross functional launch activities together with product, marketing, legal, regulatory and operations teams
• Navigate local regulatory and compliance requirements around medical cannabis and healthcare products in cooperation with legal and regulatory affairs
• Monitor performance after launch and adjust the strategy based on real market feedback
• Report progress, risks and recommendations directly to management
• Represent Bloomwell in negotiations and on market visits, with regular travel to our international markets

The position is initially limited to 18 months. This is in accordance with our internal governance and planning principles, under which we structure employment relationships for a defined period of time initially. If performance is as expected, there is generally the prospect of a long-term continuation of the employment relationship. A possible extension will be discussed well in advance of the end of the fixed-term period.

Dein Profil
• Proven experience leading or heavily driving international market expansion, including full ownership of a market launch from strategy to execution
• Experience in expanding businesses beyond German borders is a strong plus, with a solid understanding of the regulatory, cultural and commercial dynamics of these markets
• Solid understanding of the regulatory and licensing frameworks for medical cannabis in at least one international market, for example bodies such as the MHRA, EOF, FDA, DEA, Health Canada or the TGA, and the ability to quickly get up to speed on new ones
• Background in business development, strategy consulting, venture building or international growth roles
• Willingness to travel regularly
• Strong analytical skills, comfortable building business cases, market sizing models and unit economics
• Confident communicator who negotiates well and holds their own with stakeholders and international partners
• Entrepreneurial mindset, motivated by ambiguity and by building something from zero
• Structured and hands on working style, able to translate strategy into concrete execution
• Fluent English is essential for this role
• Genuine interest in the cannabis industry and health tech is a must, a background in healthcare, pharma or another regulated market is a nice plus

Warum wir?You get to actively shape things from day one, in a growing market, with flat hierarchies and real room to decide. No slow moving structures, just fast paths and an open culture where your ideas count.
This is what you can expect:
• Ownership from day one with a direct line to management
• Flexible working hours and hybrid work
• eGym Wellpass for health and fitness
• Job-Bike
• Fresh fruit, snacks and drinks in our Frankfurt office near the Messe
• Regular team events and a vibrant company culture

*We use the gender neutral abbreviation (m/w/d) to indicate that this position is open to all genders.

Über unsDie Bloomwell Group mit Sitz in Frankfurt zählt zu den führenden Unternehmen für medizinisches Cannabis in Europa. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2020 gestalten wir ein innovatives, digitales Cannabis-Ökosystem – mit dem klaren Ziel, die Versorgung von Patient:innen zu verbessern und die moderne Cannabistherapie voranzutreiben. Wir bilden die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette ab (mit Ausnahme des Anbaus) und setzen Maßstäbe in Telemedizin, eRezept-Lösungen, digitalen Zahlungswegen und datengestützter Forschung. Unsere Plattform bringt zehntausende Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen, Apotheken und Partner aus dem Großhandel jeden Monat digital zusammen – für eine neue Ära der evidenzbasierten Cannabistherapie.
Weitere Informationen unter: https://bloomwell.de/

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Postdoc in FEL Physics

Limited: 2 years | Starting date: earliest possible | ID: MPO006/2026 | Deadline: 15.10.2026 | Full-time/Part‑time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

FLASH is DESY's (and the world's first) free-electron laser user facility. Within the FLASH2020+ project, the multi-beamline FEL facility FLASH has upgraded its primary arm, FLASH1, to accommodate the first externally seeded beamline, with a 1 MHz repetition rate in burst mode. We also adapt the diagnostics on both the photon and electron beam sides to match this goal. Stability is a key factor. A stable seeded source opens the door to many new experiments. Through the ErUM-Data and LEAPS-funded proposals, we develop resource-efficient and reliable Al and machine learning methods to advance ML for photon science applications while keeping large-scale research more sustainable. We are looking for a motivated postdoc to join the team and take an essential role in advancing the capabilities of FLASH with a focus on the externally seeded FLASH1 FEL branch.

About your role:

- Investigation of the coherent properties of undulator and FEL radiation with particular emphasis on transverse and spatial coherence
- Development of machine-learning-based methods to characterize (coherent) FEL radiation and deduce electron-beam properties using non-invasive single-shot photon diagnostics
- Enhance photon diagnostic capabilities, e.g. with respect to performance on ultrashort pulses
- Integration of the developed methods into the existing FLASH diagnostic infrastructure with the aim of providing non-invasive electron-beam diagnostics and supporting beam matching and optimization
- Support of FLASH operation and participation in dedicated experiments when appropriate
- Presentation of the achieved results in scientific journals and at international conferences

About you:

- PhD or equivalent, preferably with expertise in FEL physics, accelerator physics, or related field(s)
- Strong background in physics of coherent electromagnetic radiation
- Experience with machine-learning techniques and their application to partially or fully coherent x-ray sources
- Motivation to develop diagnostic methods, concepts, or instruments for the characterization of photon pulses
- Experience with Benchmarking theory against modeled or experimental data at light-source facilities as well as experience with numerical simulations using FEL and accelerator simulation tools (e.g. GENESIS, Elegant, or equivalent) are advantageous
- Good command of high-level scripting languages (Python/Matlab) is essential
- Good command of English
- Excellent teamwork abilities in an international environment

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work‑life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information, please contact Dr. Pardis Niknejadi at +49 40 8998‑5074 (https://tel:+494089985074) (pardis.niknejadi@desy.de (pardis.niknejadi@desy.de) ).

Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation and research interests, CV, list of publications, relevant certificates and two letters of references). We look forward to receiving your application via our application portal:

Job Description

About the Job

The Industrial Supply Chain Manager (I-SCM) is responsible for managing and optimizing the manufacturing and supply chain network to ensure cost-effective, reliable, and scalable production. The role leads industrialization initiatives such as volume ramp-ups, manufacturing transfers, product changes, and supplier and factory onboardings while serving as the Supply Chain Management representative in industrialization projects.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, the I-SCM ensures that supply chain requirements are fully integrated into project execution, drives capacity and loading strategies across internal and external manufacturing sites, and supports continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply chain performance, efficiency, and resilience.

Your Responsibilities

- Lead Volume Ramp-Up (VRU) activities, manufacturing transfers, supplier and factory onboardings, and product optimization initiatives.
- Represent Supply Chain Management (SCM) in industrialization and Product Change Notification (PCN) projects, ensuring successful implementation and alignment with business objectives.
- Design and implement efficient end-to-end supply chain concepts, including material, capacity, and financial flows across internal and external manufacturing networks.
- Drive capacity planning and loading strategies by balancing internal and external manufacturing resources, ensuring compliance with contractual commitments while optimizing cost, flexibility, capacity utilization, and service levels.
- Establish and lead cross-functional capacity and loading governance processes, including the development and maintenance of planning and loading tools.
- Analyze supply chain, inventory, demand, capacity, and supplier performance data, translating insights into actionable recommendations and management decisions.
- Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and reporting tools to provide transparency, support decision-making, and monitor supply chain performance.
- Identify and drive process improvements across planning, logistics, production, and supply chain operations to enhance efficiency, visibility, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
- Support and improve system-driven processes through master data governance, data validation, process harmonization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Lead or contribute to cross-functional SCM initiatives and transformation projects, driving operational excellence and supply chain optimization.
- Proactively identify supply, capacity, and operational risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure business continuity and supply chain resilience.

Your Profile

- Master Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Manufacturing, or a comparable industry environment.
- Experience working in project-driven and cross-functional environments; exposure to industrialization or manufacturing transfer projects is considered an advantage.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively in international organizations.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business decisions.
- High level of ownership, independence, and decision-making capability combined with a hands-on mentality.
- Strong process orientation with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to manage complex activities in dynamic environments.
- Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications; experience with data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI is an advantage.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trust-based relationships across all organizational levels.
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Core Competencies

- Supply Chain & Capacity Management
- Project & Stakeholder Management
- Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen
- Data Analytics & Performance Reporting
- Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement
- Problem Solving & Decision Making
- Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Communication & Influencing Skills
- Agile Mindset & Change Management
- Attention to Detail & Execution Excellence
